content_sections.heading: AIIA Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIA Assistant Professor (Shalakya Tantra – Karna, Nasa evam Mukha Roga) (ENT) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the AIIA recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Assistant Professor (Shalakya Tantra – Karna, Nasa evam Mukha Roga) (ENT).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Professor post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted on 06 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Professor post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 101500 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree in Ayurveda, MD/MS (Ay.) in Shalakya Tantra, three years of postgraduate teaching/research experience, and at least 3 published research papers in UGC CARE listed journals.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the AIIA office in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.
